_comment: MRBRO Business Rules Configuration — Human-readable reference. Authoritative logic lives in SQL stored procedures (004_rules_engine.sql). This file documents rules for non-SQL audiences.

eventRules.rationale: If an existing engagement letter covers the matter, commercial readiness can be satisfied without a new EL
If a master agreement covers the matter, commercial readiness is satisfied

eventRules.condition: basis = 'unclear' OR basis NOT IN known values
eventRules.rationale: If commercial basis is unclear, mark as amber/red and create exception for investigation
New EL required but not yet received — this is a blocking condition
Do not auto-block the matter if no OCG is known. Unknown is a valid status.
OCG received but not yet processed — amber until reviewed

eventRules.action: Set GUIDELINE readiness to OCG_PROCESSED (Green). Resolve OCG_NOT_PROCESSED exception.
eventRules.rationale: Clean OCG processing clears guideline readiness

eventRules.action: Set GUIDELINE readiness to OCG_MATERIAL_RESTRICTIONS (Amber). Resolve OCG_NOT_PROCESSED.
eventRules.rationale: Material restrictions require billing team review and potentially modified billing procedures
Rate mismatch is a billing risk — applied rates don't match agreed rates

eventRules.action: Set RATE readiness to STANDARD_RATE (Green). Resolve all RATE and TK exceptions.
eventRules.rationale: Rate approval clears rate and related staffing exceptions

eventRules.condition: New timekeeper detected and rate approval is unresolved
eventRules.rationale: New timekeeper requires approval and rate confirmation

eventRules.condition: Unresolved staffing or rate exceptions remain
eventRules.action: Escalate severity of STAFFING and RATE exceptions (Medium→High, High→Critical). Set escalated exceptions to 'Escalated' status.
eventRules.exception: Create PREBILL_BLOCKER exception (Critical, FinanceOps) if high/critical exceptions exist
eventRules.rationale: At prebill milestone, unresolved exceptions become urgent and may block billing

eventRules.exception: Create EBILLING_SETUP_PENDING exception if not already open
eventRules.rationale: eBilling setup must be completed before invoice submission

postureRollupRules.condition: Any escalated exception OR any critical exception
postureRollupRules.rationale: Escalated or critical exceptions require leadership intervention

postureRollupRules.condition: Any red readiness dimension OR any high-severity exception
postureRollupRules.rationale: Red dimensions or high exceptions represent active billing risk
Open exceptions need attention but don't block billing
Unknown dimensions are tracked but don't block — information may arrive later

postureRollupRules.condition: All dimensions green AND no open exceptions

severityEscalationRules.action: Medium→High, High→Critical for STAFFING and RATE exceptions
